A curated collection of **GPT Image 2.5 prompts**, source examples, and practical creative workflows. Start with the image you want to make, copy a prompt, and check exactly which references it needs.

Maintained by **[Image 2.5](https://image-2-5.com)** — **[image-2-5.com](https://image-2-5.com)**. Explore the collection here, then [open Image 2.5](https://image-2-5.com) to use a prompt in your image workflow.

**16 cases · 6 categories · 7 original English prompts · 9 labeled adaptations.** Every entry links to its creator and source. Public X metrics are dated observations, not a live ranking or an independent quality test.

All launch entries are **source-checked, not independently generated or tested by this repository**. Creator result previews illustrate the source posts; they do not prove that an edited recipe reproduces those exact images.

<a id="how-to-use"></a>
## How to use

1. Choose a case and open its detail page. Copy the English prompt or the Chinese translation.
2. Supply the listed reference images. For multi-step workflows, follow the input/output order.
3. [Open Image 2.5](https://image-2-5.com) and paste the prompt into the appropriate image workflow. Links currently open the homepage; they do not automatically prefill a prompt.
4. Inspect the result. GIF recipes also need frame splitting, alignment, and file-processing tools; these exports are not promised by the homepage link.

**Prompt labels:** “Original prompt” preserves the source English wording; its Chinese block is a translation. “Editor adaptation” is our reusable rewrite of a published prompt or workflow, not the creator’s exact text. Required inputs, provenance notes, and original links live on each detail page.

<a id="data-for-your-app"></a>
## Data for your app

The human-readable collection and machine-readable catalog share one source of truth:

- [`data/prompts/`](data/prompts/): one JSON file per stable prompt ID, with bilingual text, inputs, source links, tags, model evidence, and metric timestamps.
- [`data/catalog.json`](data/catalog.json): generated catalog for search, category filters, prompt copying, and future website integration.
- [`data/site.json`](data/site.json): shared branding and website destination. Updating `promptDestination` changes every generated “Open Image 2.5” link.

```bash
node --version # Node.js 22+
npm run build
npm run check
```

No package installation, database, API key, or paid service is needed to contribute. Read the [data contract](docs/DATA_FORMAT.md) and [roadmap](docs/ROADMAP.md).

## Contribute a prompt

Found something useful? [Submit the original post](https://github.com/wangrunlin/awesome-gpt-image-2-5-prompts/issues/new?template=prompt.yml) or open a focused PR. Include the prompt, creator, result, references needed, and any dated metrics you can verify. Low-engagement discoveries are welcome.

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md), [Code of Conduct](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md), and [content corrections and removal](CONTENT_POLICY.md). English Conventional Commits and automated data checks keep contributions reviewable.
